Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.view

Class ViewManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.utils.Observable<ViewEvent,NetworkMessage>
it.polimi.myshelfie.view.View
it.polimi.myshelfie.view.ViewManager
public class ViewManager extends View
The ViewManager handles the View and all the requests that come to it. It sends NetworkMessages with the ViewEvents that happen and the information associated with them. It sets and makes updates to the modelViews based on the ViewEvents that occurred. It manages the ViewManager Observers with the UINotifier. It implements a Singleton Design Pattern.

    • getLivingRoomDiff

      public HashMap<Position,ItemTile> getLivingRoomDiff()
      Gives an HashMap from Positions to ItemTiles. The Positions are the positions that have changed in the last game update and the ItemTiles are the new ItemTiles in that position. The Positions are not center relative but are relative to the top left corner of a usual matrix.
      Returns:
      a map from Positions to ItemTiles that have changed from the previous game update

    • getCommonGoalDiff

      public List<CommonGoalModelView> getCommonGoalDiff()
      The Common Goals returned are the CommonGoals who's Tokens lists have changed compared to the last game update. The Tokens in the CommonGoals returned are the tokens that have been removed.
      Returns:
      a list of the commonGoals that have changed from the previous game update
